question: Why does the canonical model, on the frozen crypto replay, meet the Long setup on almost no pair-day and the Risk warning on most? Mechanism only: which clause, factor and regime decide each label.
interpretation: Describes the model’s own readings on historical candles. No forward price change, outcome or return is read or computed, no threshold or weight is varied, and nothing here proposes or validates a model.
replay: replayDay (scripts/scannerResearchCrypto.ts), unchanged, on every evaluation date of the frozen study; each EVALUATED result keeps the full CanonicalScore the scanner computed
reconciliation: Every replayed date equals the frozen results’ replay entry (stableSerialize), date for date
Status counts equal coverage.byStatus; Long and Risk observations, transitions, unknown onsets and standing counts equal coverage.signals
On every row, Math.round(raw) equals the recorded score and the gates reproduce the recorded setups

definitions.rows: EVALUATED members on dates the study compared (at least 15 EVALUATED); other statuses are counted apart and never enter a row denominator
definitions.raw: The unrounded composite in scoreFactors’ operation order: weight × factor summed over RSI, momentum, volatility. Every weight row sums to exactly 1 in binary64, so its division is exact
definitions.contribution: weight × factor score; the three sum to raw
definitions.shortfall: weight × (100 − factor score); the three sum to 100 − raw
definitions.veto: A factor whose shortfall alone exceeds 22.5: no value of the other two factors meets the score gate in that regime
definitions.roundingDecided: Score gate met only through rounding (raw in [77.5, 78)); low-score clause met only through rounding (raw in (28, 28.5))
definitions.transition: The condition holds and the member was EVALUATED the previous date without it; otherwise an unknown onset (not EVALUATED the day before) or standing, as the study counts
definitions.clauseOnset: One Risk clause begins (previous date EVALUATED without it). It produces a Risk transition only if Risk did not already hold through the other clause
definitions.saturation: momentum factor at 100 (>= +1%) or 0 (<= −1%); volatility factor at 100 (<= 0.5%) or 0 (>= 5.5%); RSI tails <= 30 and >= 70, where the RSI curve flattens
definitions.histogramAtrBound: sup |MACD histogram| / ATR over any candles with low <= close <= high, for the window: max over j of |hist step response at j| / ATR weight of j
definitions.riskProfileFit: The scanner’s own riskProfiles (qualifiesForRiskProfile), counted on all rows and on rows that also carry a Risk warning

notComputed: alternative thresholds, weights, windows or regimes
privacy: Per-row readings, pair tables and Long observations stay in the git-ignored output. The printed summary names no pair and no date.
